learned_force_vs_own_measured_grf.method: Trapezoid on matched saved 1 ms STO timestamps; reference GRF interpolated from measured data. No extrapolation or missing terminal sample is invented.

actor_journal_analysis.interpretation: The historical acceptance journal preserves subsequently revoked HS; the retained-after-repairs matching and final counters are separate. HS cancellation records are repairs rather than physiological zero-duration stances. Actor-valid cycles remain distinct from binary events and agreement with measured contact; an unanchored startup TO remains an explicit extra against the complete-cycle oracle.

matching_method: Existing greedy one-to-one match_events helper. Onset diagnostic tolerances inherited from online_grf_acceptance_thresholds.json: HS 0.12 s, TO 0.18 s; these are reported diagnostic references, not new acceptance gates.
scope: Saved-data read-only comparison. No new integration or policy inference. No profile, model, run, controller or old audit modifications.
